# Inventory 360

> High-performance, local-first retail enterprise POS terminal, multi-outlet stock tracking, autonomous purchase orders, and financial analytics powered by browser IndexedDB.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: Inventory 360 Enterprise
- **Website**: https://www.inventory360.shop
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Nikking18/inventory360
- **Architecture**: Local-First W3C IndexedDB, Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)

## Key Capabilities
- **Point of Sale (POS)**: Barcode scanning, thermal receipt printing (ESC/POS 80mm/58mm), discounts, split payments, cash register drawers.
- **Inventory Control**: Multi-outlet stock distribution, FIFO lot tracking, expiry date monitors, real-time SKU movements ledger.
- **Reporting & Analytics**: Retail dashboard, sales reports, inventory turnover velocity, profit margins, tax reports.
- **Omnichannel Fulfillment**: Pending dispatch, order pick lists, shipping manifests, tracking numbers.
- **Data Sovereignty**: Zero cloud lock-in, zero telemetry, automated 1-click encrypted JSON and CSV data backups.
